title: 320 m including a power head, three spaces
why: Up to 320 m the requirement could be 1, 2, 3 or 4 spaces depending on the length without the power head.

spec.name: 320 m including a power head, three spaces

wheelchair_spaces.required: ≥ 3 or ≥ 4 depending on the length without the power head
wheelchair_spaces.rationale: 4.2.2.2(1) excludes the power head. The true length is at most 320 m: above 300 m it needs 4 spaces, up to 300 m at most 3. 3 meets some of these and not others.
